about: A tree is not read leaf by leaf. What the lock names are regions, and the leaves are what a region happens to hold today: on this tree the reading lines name a few hundred regions while the readers observed thousands of leaves, about eight leaves to a region.
So the unit of observation is the region and the number of leaves is a consequence, which is why a tree that grows a thousand files does not grow a thousand questions.
